name: CBRE Group, Inc.
sector: Real Estate / Commercial real estate services
base_source: median_of_last_3_fy_oe_per_share from EDGAR 10-K (OCF - capex - SBC): FY23 $0.25, FY24 $4.07, FY25 $3.57 -> median $3.57/share (equals FY2025). TTM override computed but rejected: FY25 OCF $1,559M - H1'25 -$489M + H1'26 -$687M = $1,361M; capex $366M - $138M + $195M = $423M; SBC $120M - $63M + $107M = $164M; TTM OE $774M = $2.62/share on 295.4M H1'26 diluted shares - distorted down by H1 bonus/WC timing on acquisition-assisted growth while TTM net income rose and FY26 core EPS guidance was raised; verdict is D on either base.
moat_justification: Global #1 CRE services scale and breadth, recurring facilities/outsourcing + PM + IM mix with real switching costs, unmatched data/talent density - against a people-based advisory core whose producers can walk, un-moated transaction cyclicality (OE/share $0.25 in 2023), hard-negotiating institutional clients, and growth increasingly bought via M&A (Pearce, Industrious).
one_liner: #1 global CRE services franchise, moat 6/10 - but at $131.35 (36.8x normalized OE of $3.57/sh, 2.7% yield) the weighted IRR is just 6.4% with IV@15% of $37.94; even the super-bull case only reaches 10.0%, so it clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$38 (~$30 with a margin of safety).
